list: the official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles
counts: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation text. Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; where a method is not yet confirmed by early guides, the guide says so plainly instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no shortcut and no separate task. The road runs through the story, 100% completion for A Long Road, and then the remaining activities, collectibles and robberies. Early guides put the whole journey at roughly 200 hours (Push Square says up to 300 or more); the in-game checklist is your best friend for the final stretch.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks in the first hour of the story and cannot be missed — just play the campaign.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy that unlocks as you play. Before you finish the chapter, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy — keep playing the campaign and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Most of the list opens up once Jason and Lucia are both playable in this chapter, so use the new freedom to sample activities.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy that unlocks at the chapter's end. Keep a manual save at the chapter start — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if you want to redo anything.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy that unlocks at the chapter's end. Before moving into the finale, make a manual save — the last mission follows soon after and there is no replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Make a manual save before you start it — the game has no mission replay — then play the ending through; the gold trophy pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks when the mission ends; nothing special is needed and it cannot be missed in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks when the mission ends; nothing special is needed and it cannot be missed in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks when the mission ends; nothing special is needed and it cannot be missed in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It unlocks when the mission ends; nothing special is needed and it cannot be missed in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks when the mission ends; nothing special is needed and it cannot be missed in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks when the mission ends; nothing special is needed and it cannot be missed in a normal playthrough.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist: story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries all count toward it. This is the longest single trophy on the list and usually the last one players earn before the platinum — work through the roadmap stage by stage and let the checklist guide the cleanup.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total across Leonida, so you need a little over half of them. Stunts are the jumps, airtime and near-miss challenges marked around the map — work through them region by region and the count climbs fast.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of everything the open world offers — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games and the rest — and the trophy pops after the ninth type. A natural early trophy if you explore instead of rushing the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the toughest skill trophies on the list: learn what each range's drill scores on, pick the right weapon for it, and replay challenges until every one shows gold. Take them in short sessions rather than grinding all 42 at once.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location runs its own course — learn the gates, fly a clean line, and a win at every stop earns the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count — street, off-road or water — so pick the ones you enjoy and don't repeat the same event twice. Upgrading a favourite car for each surface helps.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, out-fish him on the day's catch, and the trophy is yours. If you lose, challenge him again — nothing is lost by retrying.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, pick a game and play it through to its end. Any single completed game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida — work through Andy's missions in order and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida — work through Kenton's missions in order and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida — work through Billy's missions in order and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore the state — finish any 8 full strands. The named character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of the same world of side content, so clear those and keep meeting strangers until the eighth strand closes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida — work through Randy's missions in order and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida — work through Tyrone's missions in order and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE — the only trophy early guides agree can be missed: one spot is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, and it disappears once that chapter ends. Meditate there before finishing Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and remember the game has no mission replay. The other 17 spots stay available in free roam.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take on Bret's hunting strand, track the unique animal he asks for, and bring it down. Bring a scoped rifle and take the shot clean.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, in hidden spots and as activity rewards. Collect every card in three full sets; check your collection often so you know which cards you still need.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo and check-in feature — use it at 100 distinct spots around the map. It pairs naturally with exploring every area for The Goodtime State, so WAiNK as you travel and the count builds itself.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the open-world objectives tracked in the pause menu — combat, driving, exploration and more. Work through them alongside everything else; 50 comes naturally over a full playthrough, and the menu shows which ones are closest to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight, hide, and stay out of sight until the heat dies down. A fast car and a quiet corner of the map help.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner beside you, keeping the wanted level alive between each — move fast from shop to shop and don't let the heat drop to zero.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or approach 100 different vehicles and each one registers as discovered. Variety beats repetition — try every class you see, from sedans and bikes to boats and aircraft.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. A busy shootout with grouped enemies is the place to try it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description is deliberately vague — leave the airport by a route no scheduled flight uses. Early guides have not yet pinned the exact trigger down, so check the linked guides for the latest method before you try it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this hidden trophy involves them. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides; check the linked guides for the latest method rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, take the goods and leave clean — being spotted at any point means starting over. Scout the store first so you know the layout.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs are spread across Leonida — crack each vault, grab the cash and escape the heat after every one. A fast getaway vehicle parked nearby makes each escape much easier.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, take its cargo and lose the wanted level. Pick a quiet stretch of road so you control the fight.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map; the count ticks up as each new area loads for the first time. Pair it with WAiNK It stops and vehicle discoveries to cover three trophies in one road trip.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations around the state — hit one operation per gang, all nine, and the trophy pops. Keep a list of which gangs you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a bar with a view over the water, and enjoy it. A quiet trophy — take a minute and soak in the sunset.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass — the classic GTA way. Expect a wanted level on the way out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley and see it through to the end. A gentle nod to the series' past — and an easy trophy once you find the alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A hidden trophy tied to a partnership moment; the exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides, so check the linked guides for the latest method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one — it rewards making choices across the game, so keep playing, keep deciding, and it will come over the course of a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed at something on your second try — a hidden trophy whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by early guides. Check the linked guides for the latest method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy for witnessing something strange in Leonida. Early guides list its method as unconfirmed — it is likely tied to one of the game's odd world events, so keep exploring and check the linked guides as the community pins it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by early guides — check the linked guides for the latest word.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It pairs with the robbery trophies, so launder after every big job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades — spending anywhere counts, and it adds up over a full playthrough. If you are short near the end, an expensive vehicle closes the gap fast.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; they also store your discovered vehicles, so they are worth owning for their own sake. Save up and buy them as they appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, register them in the Scooter Bros app, and repeat until ten are listed. It pairs with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good.
